حَمِيرٌ Anything pared, or peeled; divested, or stripped, of its superficial part, peel, bark, coat, covering, crust, or the like; as also ↓ مَحْمُورٌ . (TA.) [See 1.] ―
-b2- Also, and ↓ حَمِيرَةٌ , i. q. أُشْكُزٌّ, i. e. A thong, or strap, (S, K,) white, and having its outside pared, (S,) in a horse's saddle, (K,) or with which horses' saddles are bound, or made fast: (S:) so called because it is pared. (TA.) ＝
-A2- See also حِمَارٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
